scope: Base cumulative transactions by end of 2026 reporting period; extended x402 transaction-size sample to September 2026; funding cohorts restricted to wallets spending on >=2 distinct days

observations.notable_concentration: China-linked security/code-analysis flow was overwhelmingly to one named service, AgentLISA, according to publisher

methodology_limits: 30-day repeat funding percentages are conditional on wallets spending on >=2 distinct days; they are NOT retention rates for all new wallets or unique customers.
Geolocation is inferred and applies only to the geolocatable subset; category percentages are not shares of total transaction value.
138M is cumulative Base transaction count, not 30-day settlement volume or verified paying companies.
Micropayment distribution covers an extended sample; no category-level USD spend totals or individual buyer-provider repeat-spend panel supplied.
Wallet funding is not itself verified purchases of AgentMine or evidence of AgentMine willingness to pay.
business_implication: Prioritize independently auditable repeat buyer-to-provider spending in information/search and code-analysis niches; do not infer a profitable exchange from wallet funding or transaction counts.
